sources.title: Sejuani Build Guide: A woman and her boar: learn how to sejuani
Sejuani Build Guide: [16.11] Challenger NA & EUW In depth Sejuani Guide - Tank and Utility

passive.name: Fury of the North
passive.text: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage. Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

spells.name: Arctic Assault
spells.text: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.

spells.name: Winter's Wrath
spells.text: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.

spells.name: Permafrost
spells.text: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.

spells.name: Glacial Prison
spells.text: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.

damage.value: Sejuani deals sustained damage through a frequently available physical-damage W and repeatable max-health passive procs.

archetype.value: Sejuani is a jungle tank who ganks, controls fights with crowd control, and absorbs damage.

axis.value: Sejuani favors committed ganks that combine mobility, crowd control, and damage rather than poke.

winCondition.value: Sejuani wins by landing ganks, disrupting teamfights, and making late-game picks with R.

spikes.why: Sejuani’s ultimate makes her ganks more likely to succeed and lets her gank any lane.

spikes.at: Q cooldown falling from 18 to 12 seconds
spikes.why: Sejuani can charge and knock enemies up more often.

bait.why: After Sejuani spends Arctic Assault, its cooldown leaves Sejuani without its charge and knock-up.
After Sejuani spends Glacial Prison, its long cooldown leaves Sejuani without its ranged stun and ice storm.

mistakes.value: Sejuani players miss useful slows when they refuse to cast R without a direct hit.
Sejuani becomes vulnerable to invades when she ganks before clearing at least four camps.
Sejuani should avoid overcommitting to early ganks instead of farming toward level 6.
